title: ChatGPT Work Adds Personal Writing Style Recognition Feature

content_html:
ChatGPT Work, a product of OpenAI, has been recently updated and can now accurately identify users' unique writing styles. This feature captures details such as personal common phrases, characteristic closing statements, and capitalization habits, fully reflecting the user's personal characteristics.

By connecting daily tools such as Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, and SharePoint, ChatGPT Work can learn users' writing styles from their emails, messages, and files, and automatically apply them to subsequent content creation, helping users maintain consistent expression habits and improve work efficiency.

This improvement makes the AI assistant more closely aligned with individual usage scenarios, further enhancing the personalized experience.
